Historically explicit cases

Several U.S. policies did target people of Mexican or Latin American origin by name or in practice:

  • Mexican Repatriation (1929–1936). Local and federal officials deported or pressured out an estimated 400,000–1 million people, including many U.S. citizens. Economic
